<Helmet>
  <title>How We Built AI-Powered Pitch Training for cult Centre Managers</title>
  <meta name="font-body" content="Geist" />
  <meta name="font-display" content="Plus Jakarta Sans" />
  <style>{`
    @font-face { font-family:'Geist'; font-style:normal; font-weight:400; font-display:swap; src:url('/assets/mdx-demo/font-0.ttf') format('truetype'); }
    @font-face { font-family:'Geist'; font-style:normal; font-weight:500; font-display:swap; src:url('/assets/mdx-demo/font-1.ttf') format('truetype'); }
    @font-face { font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans'; font-style:normal; font-weight:400; font-display:swap; src:url('/assets/mdx-demo/font-2.ttf') format('truetype'); }
    @font-face { font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans'; font-style:normal; font-weight:500; font-display:swap; src:url('/assets/mdx-demo/font-3.ttf') format('truetype'); }
    @font-face { font-family:'Roboto'; font-style:normal; font-weight:400; font-display:swap; src:url('/assets/mdx-demo/font-4.ttf') format('truetype'); }
    :root { --ink:#03061c; --paper:#f2f2f2; --muted:rgba(242,242,242,.75); --violet:#8151ff; --lavender:#afaff5; --orange:#f97e28; --blue:#85b8ff; --indigo:#5353b0; --section:#212347; --periwinkle:#5353b0; }
    * { box-sizing:border-box; }
    p,h1,h2,h3,h4,ul { margin:0 !important; padding:0 !important; }
    img { display:block; }
    .case-study { position:relative; width:1280px; height:7947px; overflow:hidden; background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper); font-family:Geist,Inter,Arial,sans-serif; }
    .case-study * { text-rendering:geometricPrecision; }
    @media (max-width: 767px) {
      .case-study { width:100%; height:auto; min-height:var(--mx-vh,760px); overflow:hidden; }
      .case-study > section, .case-study > div:not(.hero-grid) { max-width:100%; }
    }
    .case-display { font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',Inter,Arial,sans-serif; }
    .case-mono { font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace; }
    .marker { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; height:16px; font-size:12px; line-height:normal; letter-spacing:.96px; text-transform:uppercase; white-space:nowrap; }
    .rule { height:3px; flex:1; min-width:1px; background:#5353b0; }
    .gradient-heading { background:linear-gradient(168deg,#fff 3%,#aa9cfc 104%); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent; }
    .orange-heading { background:linear-gradient(168deg,#fff 6%,#f97e28 100%); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent; }
    .hero-grid { background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.035) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.035) 1px,transparent 1px); background-size:32px 32px; mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,black 16%,black 84%,transparent); opacity:.42; }
    .hero-glow { background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.035) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.035) 1px,transparent 1px),radial-gradient(circle at 80% 17%,rgba(129,81,255,.3),transparent 27%),radial-gradient(circle at 72% 18%,rgba(83,83,176,.18),transparent 40%); background-size:32px 32px,32px 32px,auto,auto; mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,black 16%,black 84%,transparent); opacity:.42; }
    .hero-glow::before { content:""; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:0; height:520px; border-radius:0 0 22px 22px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#212347 0%,#212347 88%,rgba(33,35,71,0) 100%); opacity:.9; }
    .soft-card { border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.33); }
    .question-card { background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(89,106,197,.2),rgba(89,106,197,0)),#212347; }
    #conversation { background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(89,106,197,.2),rgba(89,106,197,0)),linear-gradient(90deg,#212347,#212347); }
    .quote-panel { background:#f97e28; color:#03061c; }
    .quote-panel p:last-child { color:rgba(3,6,28,.8); }
    .concept-card,.metric-card { background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(34,36,71,.2),rgba(34,36,71,0)),#03061c; }
    .system-card { background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(89,106,197,.2),rgba(89,106,197,0)),#212347; }
    .wave-bar { background:#85b8ff; border-radius:999px; }
    .wave-bar-violet { background:#8151ff; border-radius:999px; }
    .shoutout-bg { background:#03061c; }
    .shoutout-rays-wrap { position:absolute; left:-1051px; top:-248px; width:1752px; height:1757px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; z-index:0; pointer-events:none; }
    .shoutout-rays { display:block; width:1282.63px; height:1297.44px; transform:rotate(-29.16deg); }
    .shoutout-bubble { position:absolute; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:60.64px; padding:14.701px 22.052px; border:1.838px solid; box-sizing:border-box; color:white; font-family:Roboto,Arial,sans-serif; font-size:22.052px; line-height:29.402px; white-space:nowrap; z-index:2; }
    .shoutout-cursor { position:absolute; width:44.104px; height:44.104px; overflow:visible; z-index:3; pointer-events:none; }
    .shoutout-cursor .cursor-shape { position:absolute; width:23px; height:26.522px; }
    .shoutout-cursor img { position:absolute; left:-8.047px; top:-6.627px; width:39.9618px; height:42.8833px; max-width:none; }
    .bubble-san { left:305px; top:65px; width:137px; border-color:#b89dff; border-radius:29.402px 22.052px 1.838px 29.402px; }
    .cursor-san { left:434px; top:117px; }
    .cursor-san .cursor-shape { left:7.78px; top:13.91px; transform:rotate(180deg); }
    .bubble-sau { left:792px; top:92px; width:191px; border-color:#87cdff; border-radius:22.052px 29.402px 29.402px 1.838px; }
    .cursor-sau { left:758px; top:144px; }
    .cursor-sau .cursor-shape { left:5.91px; top:13.91px; transform:scaleY(-1); }
    .bubble-nit { left:121px; top:336px; width:130px; border-color:#ffcaaf; border-radius:29.402px 1.838px 22.052px 29.402px; }
    .cursor-nit { left:242px; top:298px; }
    .cursor-nit .cursor-shape { left:7.78px; top:3.68px; transform:rotate(180deg) scaleY(-1); }
    .bubble-neha { left:1029px; top:270px; width:152px; border-color:#b89dff; border-radius:1.838px 29.402px 29.402px 22.052px; }
    .cursor-neha { left:997px; top:232px; }
    .cursor-neha .cursor-shape { left:5.91px; top:3.68px; }
    .bubble-ash { left:358px; top:446px; width:212px; border-color:#87cdff; border-radius:29.402px 1.838px 22.052px 29.402px; }

/* Figma frame 112:42: preserve the desktop canvas and reflow the mobile companion. */
.pitch-shell { width:100%; max-width:1280px; margin:0 auto; container-type:inline-size; }
.case-study { margin:0; }
.pitch-hero, .pitch-premise { display:contents; }
.case-study #heroBg { display:none; }
.case-study .hero-panel-artboard { top:0; }
.case-study .hero-panel-left { position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:1057px; height:518px; overflow:hidden; clip-path:path('M20 0H1037Q1057 0 1057 20V49Q1057 70 1038 77C958 96 897 159 897 244C897 329 958 391 1038 411Q1057 418 1057 439V498Q1057 518 1037 518H20Q0 518 0 498V20Q0 0 20 0Z'); }
.case-study .hero-panel-art-left { width:1280px; height:628px; top:-55px; }

.case-study .hero-panel-trace-left-top { left:818px; top:36px; transform:scaleX(-1); }
.case-study .hero-panel-trace-left-bottom { left:818px; top:381px; transform:rotate(180deg); }
.case-study .hero-panel-trace-right-top { top:36px; transform:none; }
.case-study .hero-panel-trace-right-bottom { top:381px; }
.case-study .hero-dot-left-top { top:39px; }
.case-study .hero-dot-left-bottom { top:439px; }

.case-study .hero-bar-left-bottom, .case-study .hero-bar-right-bottom { top:386px; }

.case-study .hero-sphere-blur { opacity:.4; }

.case-study #pWXB > div { background:rgba(255,255,255,.26) !important; color:#03061c !important; }

  .case-study { zoom:calc(100cqw / 1280px); }
}
@media (max-width:767px) {
  .case-study { width:100%; height:auto; min-height:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; overflow:hidden; }

  .case-study .hero-mobile-bg-wrap { width:100%; left:0; top:-305px; height:800px; overflow:visible; }
  .case-study .hero-mobile-bg { left:calc(50% - 400px); top:calc((800px - 100cqw) / 2); width:800px; height:100cqw; transform:rotate(-90deg) scaleY(-1); }
  .case-study .hero-panel-artboard { width:100%; height:648px; }

        <div className="question-card h-[344px] w-full overflow-hidden rounded-[18px] p-10" id="hnLJ">
          <div className="text-[12px] uppercase tracking-[1.2px] text-[#b395ff]">
            The question
          </div>

          <div className="case-display mt-[10px] text-[38px] leading-[1.12] tracking-[-.76px] text-[#f8f7f3]">
            Could we make pitch training feel like an actual conversation?
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="absolute left-[450px] top-[677px] h-[622px] w-[774px] overflow-hidden" id="context">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-10" id="o4JM">
          <div className="h-[196px] overflow-hidden text-[18px] leading-[1.58] text-[rgba(242,242,242,.75)]">
            When my team and I looked at center managers pitch training across cult centres for prospective members, we realised there was a gap between knowing the pitch and applying it in real conversations. They were trained on what to say, but customer conversations rarely followed a fixed script. When prospective members raised unexpected fitness concerns or nuanced questions, newer managers sometimes struggled to adapt in the moment. It wasn’t because they lacked the information, but because they had limited opportunities to practise handling situations outside the standard pitch.
          </div>

          <div className="h-[84px] overflow-hidden text-[18px] leading-[1.58] text-[rgba(242,242,242,.75)]">
            As cult expanded, we needed a way to give managers more opportunities to practise these situations without making training dependent on one-on-one coaching or repeated classroom sessions.
          </div>

          <div className="quote-panel h-[262px] w-full rounded-[20px] p-6" id="JZkp">
            <div className="text-[24px] leading-[1.25]">
              “The real challenge wasn’t teaching Centre Managers on what to say...it was helping them adapt to every kind of customer conversation. With AI-powered personas, we could give managers personalised practice across different consumer types and scenarios, helping them build confidence while ensuring every prospective member received the right guidance.”
            </div>

            <div className="mt-4 text-[14px] text-[rgba(242,242,242,.75)]">
              Chaitanya Gupta · Engineering Lead, cult
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section className="absolute left-0 top-[1394px] h-[1752px] w-full overflow-hidden bg-[#212347]" id="conversation">
      <div className="absolute left-[56px] top-[112px] h-[258px] w-[1168px]" id="lfP8">

        </div>

        <div className="absolute left-[394px] top-0 w-[774px]" id="qknM">
          <div className="case-display gradient-heading text-[52px] leading-[1.02] tracking-[-1.56px]">
            ## We Turned Pitch Training Into a Conversation
          </div>

          <div className="mt-10 text-[18px] leading-[1.58] text-[rgba(242,242,242,.75)]">
            We didn't want Centre Managers to learn the pitch by reading another document or answering a fixed set of questions. We wanted to see how they handled the conversation itself. So I worked with the team to build an AI voice-based training experience that could simulate different prospects.
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="absolute left-[56px] top-[470px] flex h-[311px] w-[1168px] gap-6" id="QnKh">
        <div className="concept-card soft-card h-[311px] w-[572px] rounded-[20px] p-10" id="VFUl">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between" id="xfjq">
            <div className="text-[12px] uppercase tracking-[.96px] text-[#85b8ff]">
              Persona model
            </div>

            <span className="hero-signal bg-[#85b8ff]" id="izLR" />
          </div>

          <div className="mt-6 text-[24px] leading-[1.12]">
            ### One pitch. Many kinds of prospect.
          </div>

          <div className="mt-6 text-[18px] leading-[1.58] text-[rgba(242,242,242,.75)]">
            Instead of giving every manager the same conversation, we could simulate complete beginners, experienced athletes and more challenging negotiators. Each persona could be calibrated to a difficulty level and brought together into structured training modules.
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="concept-card soft-card h-[311px] w-[572px] rounded-[20px] p-10" id="fQn1">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between" id="cd1U">
            <div className="text-[12px] uppercase tracking-[.96px] text-[#f97e28]">
              Assessment criteria
            </div>

            <span className="hero-signal bg-[#f97e28]" id="MGZk" />
          </div>

          <div className="mt-6 text-[24px] leading-[1.12]">
            ### Judge the scenario, not a fixed script.
          </div>

          <div className="mt-6 text-[18px] leading-[1.58] text-[rgba(242,242,242,.75)]">
            Each conversation could be evaluated against parameters defined for that persona such as active listening, objection handling or pitch accuracy with those parameters passed to the LLM as part of the assessment prompt.
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="absolute left-[56px] top-[881px] flex h-[172px] w-[1168px] gap-10" id="egBE">
        <div className="gradient-heading case-display w-[430px] text-[38px] leading-[1.12] tracking-[-.76px]">
          ### If every conversation can take a different path, how do we decide whether a manager handled it well?
        </div>

        <div className="flex h-[172px] flex-1 flex-col gap-4 border-l-[3px] border-[#5353b0] pl-10" id="wuWi">
          <div className="text-[12px] uppercase tracking-[.96px]">
            The answer
          </div>

          <div className="text-[18px] leading-[1.58] text-[rgba(242,242,242,.75)]">
            Define assessment criteria for each persona. This meant the conversation could be judged against criteria relevant to the scenario rather than a single fixed checklist. The assessment then generated a score that could be compared against the passing score configured for that persona within the training module.
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="absolute left-[56px] top-[346px] h-[732px] w-[1168px]" id="Fg60">
        <div className="absolute left-0 top-0 h-[637px] w-[430px] rounded-[20px] bg-[#03061c] p-10" id="SszE">
          <div className="text-[24px] leading-normal">
            ### The first version worked.<br />The setup didn’t.
          </div>

          <div className="mt-10 text-[14px] leading-[1.4] text-[rgba(242,242,242,.75)]">
            The first version of the assessment ran through the Partner Portal as a web experience. It worked, but the setup created a few practical problems:
          </div>

          <div className="mt-10 flex flex-col gap-6 text-[14px] leading-[1.58] text-[rgba(242,242,242,.75)]" id="h5sP">

              </span>

            <div className="flex gap-4" id="cHid">
              <span className="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#5353b0] text-white" id="DPiV">
                ×
              </span>

            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-4" id="vN8f">
              <span className="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#5353b0] text-white" id="ArpN">
                ×
              </span>

              Carrying a laptop around the centre wasn't always practical.
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-4" id="jP7Z">
              <span className="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#5353b0] text-white" id="HVRq">
                ×
              </span>

              The web-based setup gave managers less flexibility over when they could complete the training.
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="absolute left-[510px] top-0 h-[732px] w-[658px]" id="BOpV">
          <div className="case-display text-[38px] leading-[1.12] tracking-[-.76px]">
            ### Meet managers where<br />they already work
          </div>

          <div className="absolute top-[146px] text-[18px] leading-[1.58] text-[rgba(242,242,242,.75)]">
            We realised the problem wasn't the training itself. It was how managers were accessing it. We moved the training experience into Teams, an app that Centre Managers and Trainers already use as part of their everyday work, including marking attendance and checking member check-ins at the centre.
          </div>

          <div className="absolute top-[318px] text-[18px] leading-[1.58] text-[rgba(242,242,242,.75)]">
            That made it possible to run shorter voice simulations within a tool managers were already using, without requiring a separate device or workflow.
          </div>

          <div className="absolute top-[434px] h-[163px] w-full rounded-[20px] border-2 border-[#f2f2f2] bg-[linear-gradient(159deg,rgba(255,255,255,.2),rgba(170,156,252,.2))] p-6" id="BV9k">
            <div className="text-[24px] leading-[1.12] tracking-[-.24px]">
              “The AI pitch training is helping us improve our communication skills. It is good for practice and also helps build our confidence.”

            <div className="mt-4 list-disc text-[14px]">

            </div>

            <div className="absolute left-[573px] top-[569px] h-14 w-14 overflow-hidden rounded-full border-[3px] border-white bg-[#f97e28]" id="NqOJ">
              <img className="h-full w-full object-cover" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="" id="GFe3" />

        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="absolute left-[56px] top-[318px] flex h-[84px] w-[1168px] gap-16" id="WXxy">
        <div className="w-[330px] text-[14px]">
          BEYOND THE CALL
        </div>

        <div className="w-[780px] text-[18px] leading-[1.58] text-[rgba(242,242,242,.75)]">
          The voice conversation was only one part of the system. We also needed to know who was having it, which training module it belonged to and what happened during the interaction. We separated those responsibilities into a few layers.
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="absolute left-[56px] top-[502px] flex h-[260px] w-[1168px] gap-4" id="vtwu">
        <div className="system-card flex h-[260px] w-[378px] flex-col justify-between rounded-[20px] p-6" id="RWJw">
          <div className="text-[12px] text-[#afaff5]">
            01 / PERSONA
          </div>

          <div id="lsT6">
            <div className="text-[24px] leading-[1.12]">
              ### Simulated prospect
            </div>

            <div className="mt-[10px] text-[14px] leading-[1.4] text-[#b8b5ae]">
              An agent persona defines the customer, their context, difficulty and the objections a manager must navigate.
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="system-card flex h-[260px] w-[378px] flex-col justify-between rounded-[20px] p-6" id="oFOk">
          <div className="text-[12px] text-[#afaff5]">
            02 / CURRICULUM
          </div>

          <div id="w8le">
            <div className="text-[24px] leading-[1.12]">
              ### Training module
            </div>

            <div className="mt-[10px] text-[14px] leading-[1.4] text-[#b8b5ae]">
              A module brings personas into a curriculum. Their mapping controls order, passing score and retry rules.
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="system-card flex h-[260px] w-[378px] flex-col justify-between rounded-[20px] p-6" id="on3n">
          <div className="text-[12px] text-[#afaff5]">
            03 / ASSIGNMENT
          </div>

          <div id="g8MM">
            <div className="text-[24px] leading-[1.12]">
              ### Employee mapping
            </div>

            <div className="mt-[10px] text-[14px] leading-[1.4] text-[#b8b5ae]">
              A second mapping connects the module to the employee taking it, so every attempt belongs to a learning journey.
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="absolute left-[56px] top-[862px] flex h-[248px] w-[1168px] gap-16 border-y border-[rgba(242,242,242,.75)] py-10" id="HFM4">
        <div className="w-[330px] text-[38px] leading-[1.12] tracking-[-.76px]">
          ### One ID ties every attempt together.
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 text-[18px] leading-[1.58] text-[rgba(242,242,242,.75)]">
          When a manager started a conversation, the system created an assessment entry. A unique Conversation ID linked the audio, transcript and metrics to that attempt. Once processed, the interaction was evaluated for active listening, objection handling and pitch accuracy, to determine a clear passing score that showed managers where they needed to improve. The L\&D team could create modules, assign them to employees and track performance, including access to interaction recordings.
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="absolute left-[56px] top-[1210px] h-[268px] w-[1168px] rounded-[20px] bg-[#f97e28] p-10" id="jaSj">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between" id="pCzr">

          </div>

          <div className="text-[14px]">

          </div>
        </div>

    <section className="absolute left-0 top-[5904px] h-[1406px] w-full overflow-hidden bg-[#212347]" id="impact">
      <div className="absolute left-[56px] top-[112px] h-[90px] w-[1168px]" id="j5J2">
        <div className="flex h-4 w-[330px] items-center" id="nNG3">
          <span className="ml-[10px] text-[12px] tracking-[.96px]" id="LeS9">05 / impact</span>
        </div>

        <div className="case-display absolute left-[394px] top-0 whitespace-nowrap text-[52px] leading-[1.12] tracking-[-1.56px]">
          ## Voice AI at scale and its impact
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="absolute left-[56px] top-[302px] flex h-[220px] w-[1168px] gap-4" id="DfKV">
        <div className="metric-card h-[220px] w-[280px] rounded-[20px] border border-white/20 px-6 py-[30px]" id="LU1U">
          <div className="text-[64px] leading-[1.02] tracking-[-2.56px] text-[#afaff5]">
            20×
          </div>

          <div className="mt-5 text-[14px] leading-[1.4] text-[#b8b5ae]">
            growth in assessment attempts between December and May
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="metric-card h-[220px] w-[280px] rounded-[20px] border border-white/20 px-6 py-[30px]" id="mvHK">
          <div className="text-[64px] leading-[1.02] tracking-[-2.56px] text-[#f97e28]">
            \>90%
          </div>

          <div className="mt-5 text-[14px] leading-[1.4] text-[#b8b5ae]">
            completion rate, sustained through June and July
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="metric-card h-[220px] w-[280px] rounded-[20px] border border-white/20 px-6 py-[30px]" id="f09t">
          <div className="text-[64px] leading-[1.02] tracking-[-2.56px] text-[#85b8ff]">
            2×
          </div>

          <div className="mt-5 text-[14px] leading-[1.4] text-[#b8b5ae]">
            improvement in first-sale conversion after training
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="metric-card h-[220px] w-[280px] rounded-[20px] border border-white/20 px-6 py-[30px]" id="pT20">
          <div className="text-[64px] leading-[1.02] tracking-[-2.56px] text-[#8151ff]">
            30–45
          </div>

          <div className="mt-5 text-[14px] leading-[1.4] text-[#b8b5ae]">
            days in a typical self-paced completion window
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="absolute left-[56px] top-[622px] flex h-[300px] w-[1168px] gap-16" id="GEte">
        <div className="flex h-[191px] w-[330px] flex-col gap-6" id="UaQN">
          <div className="text-[38px] leading-[1.12] tracking-[-.76px]">
            ### Fewer calls. More structured learning.
          </div>

          <div className="text-[24px] leading-[1.12] text-[#afaff5]">
            The aim wasn’t just to have fewer conversations. It was to make each one count.
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-6 text-[18px] leading-[1.58]" id="GRW1">
          We deliberately designed the tool around broad completion timelines, typically 30 to 45 days. Within that window, managers can train at their own pace across multiple stages, each featuring a distinct persona and difficulty level. Managers move through those stages in sequence. Pass, and the next stage opens. Fail, and they retry the same stage.

          This timeline structure allows managers to complete the curriculum across multiple self-paced sessions. Admins can create modules, decide how they are structured and assign them to employees. The system then tracks progress across the module rather than treating each conversation as a separate attempt.

          Voice interactions became part of a structured learning cycle rather than the training itself.
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="absolute left-[56px] top-[1022px] flex h-[272px] w-[1168px] gap-6 rounded-[20px] bg-[#f97e28] p-10" id="I9fU">
        <div className="w-[330px] text-[38px] leading-[1.12] tracking-[-.76px]">
          ### What the new model makes possible
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-6 text-[18px] leading-[1.58] text-[rgba(242,242,242,.75)]" id="txFe">
          The new model changed more than the training schedule. For our engineering and L\&D teams, it provided a holistic view of skill development across a full learning journey rather than judging performance on isolated call snapshots.

          The architecture also leaves room for multiple training modules and different learning journeys for different employee groups. Future iterations can build on the same foundation with more flexible programmes and deeper performance analytics.
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
